brief.headline: Alpha 4.8 adds a coordinated Nyx assault, saved ship loadouts and a substantial refueling overhaul.
takeaways: Tactical Strike Group combines ship combat, station sabotage and an infantry rescue.
Save your ship configuration at ASOP before claiming an insured loadout.
Flight suits improve g-force tolerance; combat armor reduces it.

newContent.title: Tactical Strike Group
newContent.detail: The six-stage contract is designed for organized groups using at least seven ships.

newContent.title: Refueling contracts
newContent.detail: New contracts and distress beacons accompany revised docking, fuel pods and automatic fuel transfer.

newContent.title: Vehicle recovery
newContent.detail: ASOP snapshots preserve eligible equipment; insured claims cost aUEC. The Ironclad lineup also arrives.

fixes.title: Inventory and missions
fixes.detail: Fixes address stacking, capacity displays and missing Contested Zone loot.

fixes.title: Combat
fixes.detail: Fixes address excessive hit damage and an armor setup that made heavy fighters immune.

knownIssues.title: Navigation and hangars
knownIssues.detail: Some quantum destinations cannot be reached; hangar queues can leave doors closed.

knownIssues.title: Grenade warnings
knownIssues.detail: Live grenades may lack nearby HUD warning markers.

watchouts: Ammo and missiles are excluded from insured claims.
Claiming a registered item disables its previous copy after a grace period.

brief.headline: Star Citizen Alpha 4.10.0 releases to LIVE featuring on-demand instancing for the reworked Siege of Orison, Recco Battaglia's return, and broad vehicle armor and fuel rebalances.
takeaways: Instancing on Demand debuts with Siege of Orison V2 as an FPS-only, 4-player private instance with checkpoint respawns.
Recco Battaglia returns to Levski with multi-tier mining, defense, and recovery contracts rewarding hardware and blueprints.
Ship armor no longer absorbs damage when destroyed, fuel tank capacities and consumption are rebalanced, and fuel prices have substantially increased.
New gear arrives including the BUL-H4 Super Heavy Armor, Vendetta HMG, and the switchable DMR/shotgun HDGW Arlington Rifle.

newContent.title: Instancing on Demand & Siege of Orison V2
newContent.detail: Adds closed private instances for parties up to 4 players, starting with the reworked FPS-only Siege of Orison featuring fresh Nine Tails armor tiers, boss encounters, and unlimited medical bed respawn checkpoints.

newContent.title: Recco Battaglia Mission Giver
newContent.detail: Introduces Recco Battaglia in Levski with three initial story missions and unlockable contract tiers for rock cracking, miner defense, missing persons, and item recovery, offering blueprints and mining components as rewards.

newContent.title: BUL-H4 Armor and Vendetta HMG
newContent.detail: Adds a super heavy one-piece armor set, a specialized ammo backpack, and the Apocalypse Arms Vendetta heavy machine gun, which allows party members to reload the wearer via tractor beam or hand placement.

newContent.title: HDGW Arlington Rifle
newContent.detail: Introduces a switchable lever-action ballistic rifle capable of firing single DMR rounds at 550 m/s or 8-pellet shotgun blasts at 300 m/s, accompanied by a dedicated HDGW optic.

newContent.title: Wikelo Exchange Ship & Blueprint Crafting
newContent.detail: Wikelo now offers ship exchanges requiring crafted items via single-use blueprints, alongside armor and weapon trades that reward reusable crafting blueprints.

newContent.title: New Vehicle Purchases and Variants
newContent.detail: Adds the Kruger L-22 Alphawolf, MISC Hull B, Drake Golem OX, and GRIN UTV to in-game dealerships, replaces the RSI Aurora Mk I with the Mk II in shops, and grants the Kruger P-52 Merlin an editable center gimbal mount.

fixes.title: Cargo and Freight Elevators
fixes.detail: Fixed multiple issues causing missing cargo on terminals, platform freezes on the Transferring screen, and greyed-out claim buttons.

fixes.title: Mission AI and Hostile Spawns
fixes.detail: Corrected bugs preventing hostile and target spawns in Eliminate All, Expel Outlaws, planetary bounties, and Vanduul encounters.

fixes.title: Escort and Refueling Missions
fixes.detail: Resolved broken objectives, uncooperative escort ships failing to quantum or enter hangars, and docking request failures during refueling runs.

fixes.title: Hangar Life Support and Ship Power
fixes.detail: Fixed hangar suffocation with active ship life support, as well as unresponsive powerplants on stored and retrieved Drake Ironclad, Ironclad Assault, and Caterpillar ships.

fixes.title: Client and Engine Stability
fixes.detail: Resolved 20 client crashes, 20 server crashes, threading/memory errors, and physics stalls to improve overall client performance and streaming.

whoItAffects: Combat and FPS players participating in the updated Siege of Orison or using the new super-heavy loadouts.
Industrial players and miners taking contracts from Recco Battaglia or managing cargo persistence.
Pilots navigating changes to vehicle armor health, Size 4 ballistic weapons, fuel consumption, and higher operating cost
VR users utilizing experimental head tracking, stereo cursor updates, and OpenXR 1.1.60 improvements.
watchouts: Vehicle armor sitting at zero health no longer mitigates incoming damage.
Quantum and hydrogen fuel prices have substantially increased alongside reduced tank capacities.
Ship claim timers scale by value, expediting costs more, and ordnance/bomb restock prices are sharply higher.
Only cargo and ore containers acquired after 4.10 will persist in Long Term Persistence; stock ship ore pods do not persist contained ore.
Vehicles left in Wikelo's hangar cannot be stored there and will be returned to your home hangar.

brief.headline: Star Citizen Alpha 4.9.0 introduces Recco Battaglia contracts, new ship combat hit markers, and expanded cargo grid support for ordnance.
takeaways: New repeatable missions from Recco Battaglia in Levski offer exclusive armor blueprints, weapon components, and ship variants.
Ship combat receives real-time visual reticle feedback and dedicated three-layer audio cues for armor, component, and hull hits.
Missiles and torpedoes now display bounding box frames and holographic alignment previews on cargo grids.
New FPS equipment arrives via the Behring CQ7 Bullpup Rifle and the armored Bellator Combat Suit.

newContent.title: Recco Battaglia Missions
newContent.detail: Repeatable Levski-based contracts spanning mining, salvage, recovery, and ship reclamation that reward blueprints and unique industrial ship variants.

newContent.title: Vehicle Combat Hit Markers
newContent.detail: Reticle visual states and distinct audio layers provide immediate feedback for shield hits, armor damage, hull penetration, and component destruction.

newContent.title: Ordnance Cargo Holders
newContent.detail: Missiles and torpedoes placed on cargo grids now display bounding boxes and holographic snap previews to control orientation.

newContent.title: Behring CQ7 Bullpup Rifle & Bellator Suit
newContent.detail: Adds a standard 650 RPM rifle found in missions and shops, alongside formal civilian attire offering light damage mitigation and weapon slots.

fixes.title: Inventory and Freight Elevators
fixes.detail: Resolved issues where inventories appeared empty, items were deleted when raised on freight elevators, and kiosks got stuck loading.

fixes.title: Docking and Hangars
fixes.detail: Fixed docking collar failures, refueling connection bugs, exterior hangar doors remaining closed, and incorrect hangar size spawns.

fixes.title: Navigation and Jump Points
fixes.detail: Addressed immediate quantum route resets and fixed jump point tunnels looping players back into their origin system.

fixes.title: Connection Error Codes
fixes.detail: Resolved error codes 64008, 64006, and 60029 that caused disconnection or prevented players from joining the Persistent Universe.

watchouts: Ballistic repeater damage has been greatly reduced across the board.
Experimental scanning changes are active on LIVE to monitor system stability.
Abandoned ships at major landing zones and stations are now removed after 5 hours.

brief.headline: Star Citizen Alpha 4.8.1 is now live, introducing the Defend Location mission archetype to Ship Battles V3.
takeaways: Defend Location missions task players with intercepting bombers targeting critical infrastructure across Stanton, Pyro, and Nyx asteroid mining bases.
A combined mission variant introduces simultaneous escort and defense objectives.
Existing Escort Ship missions are updated with Ace Pilot spawns and varied flight paths.
Rewards include aUEC, faction reputation, organization scrip, and blueprints at higher tiers.

newContent.title: Defend Location Missions
newContent.detail: Players must intercept coordinated enemy bomber strafing runs targeting fuel storage and infrastructure before critical damage is sustained.

newContent.title: Combined Escort and Defense Variant
newContent.detail: Layers a friendly ship escort objective over the base defense, requiring players to protect a landing or launching craft from hostile fighters simultaneously.

newContent.title: Escort Ship V2 Updates
newContent.detail: Adds Ace Pilot spawns and more varied flight paths to existing escort missions to increase challenge and unpredictability.

newContent.title: Mission Availability and Tiers
newContent.detail: Spans 385 locations across 149 asteroid mining bases with 6 difficulty tiers ranging from Very Easy to Super tier.

whoItAffects: Combat pilots and mercenary players running Ship Battles missions
Players operating in Stanton, Pyro, and Nyx asteroid bases
watchouts: Combined variants fail if either the base defense or the escort ship fails
Missions have a 15-minute abandoned and personal cooldown period
Reputation gates apply, and Foxwell contracts require completing the Foxwell intro mission

brief.headline: Star Citizen Alpha 4.7.2 is now live, introducing Nyx Mission Pack 2 with new combat, delivery, salvage, and cargo contracts across multiple systems.
takeaways: Nyx Mission Pack 2 adds diverse contracts across Stanton, Nyx, and Pyro.
Delivery gameplay expands with two-handed courier runs and derelict cargo recovery contracts.
Combat options expand with sequential ship wave defense, targeted bounties, and reintroduced bombing runs.
Salvage operators can access lawful paid derelict contracts issued by Adagio across all systems.

newContent.title: Delivery Contracts (Courier & Recover Cargo)
newContent.detail: Adds local courier runs moving two-handed deliverables between outposts, stations, and landing zones in Stanton and Nyx, as well as cargo recovery missions tasking players to retrieve between one and six 1 SCU boxes from ships in space.

newContent.title: Combat Missions (Ship Waves & Bounties)
newContent.detail: Features ship wave attack contracts against sequential enemy fighter groups in Nyx and Pyro space, alongside new bounty hunting contracts targeting specific criminal ships near Nyx Rock Cracker sites.

newContent.title: Combat: Bombing Runs
newContent.detail: Reimplements lawful and unlawful bombing run missions to destroy fuel infrastructure and critical installations defended by turrets and hostile ships at Stanton asteroid bases and distribution centers.

newContent.title: Salvage: Paid Salvage
newContent.detail: Adagio now issues lawful paid salvage contracts across all systems directing players to derelict vessel locations for stripping and processing.

whoItAffects: Haulers and couriers operating in Stanton and Nyx
Combat pilots and bounty hunters in Stanton, Nyx, and Pyro
Salvage operators seeking lawful contracts across all systems
watchouts: Bombing run targets are defended by both hostile ships and surface turrets.
Ship wave missions require clearing each sequential enemy fighter group before the next triggers.

brief.headline: Alpha 4.7 introduces item crafting, a redesigned inventory and new mining missions in Nyx.
takeaways: Craft equipment in an Item Fabricator using blueprints and gathered materials.
Material quality affects crafted stats and survives refining.
Inventory now supports two panels, nearby containers, search and filters.

newContent.title: Crafting and dismantling
newContent.detail: Blueprints unlock recipes; eligible equipment can be dismantled to recover materials.

newContent.title: Breaker Stations
newContent.detail: Restore asteroid mining stations through combat, puzzles and hazards; contracts offer shared or exclusive access.

newContent.title: Ships and services
newContent.detail: The Aurora Mk II and four People's Service Stations arrive. Installed radars now govern aim-assist range.

fixes.title: Mission progression
fixes.detail: Fixes address incomplete cargo objectives, incorrect payouts and missing freight-elevator destinations.

fixes.title: Vehicles and travel
fixes.detail: Fixes address blank MFDs, engines stopping during mode changes and closing jump-gate failures.

knownIssues.title: Stack All disabled
knownIssues.detail: The automatic stacking button is temporarily disabled in LIVE; manual stacking remains available.

knownIssues.title: Cargo and locations
knownIssues.detail: Commodity buying can stay locked until freight is removed; some Levski shop floors lack collision.

watchouts: Two players cannot open the same container simultaneously.
Poor-quality inputs can worsen crafted stats or fail a recipe's minimum requirements.

brief.headline: Star Citizen Alpha 4.8.2 is now live, delivering unstowing fixes, new ships, and key bug fixes for Drake and Argo vessels.
takeaways: Resolves character unstowing problems and fixes players stuck in stowed states.
Addresses life-support and atmosphere hazards on the Drake Ironclad and Command Module.
Fixes VTOL thrust shortfalls on the Drake Ironclad Assault and pilot seat exit issues on the Argo MPUV Tractor.
Corrects unresponsive AI characters across multiple locations in all star systems.

newContent.title: New Ships
newContent.detail: Alpha 4.8.2 introduces new ships to the LIVE servers.

fixes.title: Character Stowing Maintenance
fixes.detail: Applied fixes for unstowing characters and restored player characters previously stuck in a stowed state.

fixes.title: Drake Ironclad & Command Module Life Support
fixes.detail: Addressed atmosphere simulation issues that caused dramatic HPA and temperature spikes, as well as asphyxiation while wearing helmets.

fixes.title: Drake Ironclad Assault VTOL Thrust
fixes.detail: Fixed an issue where the ship lacked sufficient VTOL thrust to lift off from landing pads while loaded with cargo.

fixes.title: Argo MPUV Flight and Exit Issues
fixes.detail: Corrected improper acceleration from misrotated thrusters and fixed an issue preventing players from exiting the MPUV Tractor pilot seat.

whoItAffects: Players stuck in a stowed character state
Drake Ironclad and Command Module pilots and crew
Argo MPUV and MPUV Tractor operators
Players running escort missions or encountering unresponsive AI
watchouts: Ironclad atmosphere issues are marked as potential fixes and may require monitoring during flight.
ATC may previously have assigned docking ports over pads at dual-support facilities.

brief.headline: Alpha 4.6 centers on the Levski relief event, cockpit light amplification and engineering improvements.
takeaways: Alliance Aid contracts support the limited-time response to Levski's Molina Mold outbreak.
Supported ships gain LAMP cockpit light amplification, toggled with Right Alt + L.
Repaired ship components must reach 10% health before functioning again.

newContent.title: Relief operations
newContent.detail: Transport, Defense and Collection divisions offer progress rewards and unlock one-time milestone missions.

newContent.title: Ship supplies
newContent.detail: Kel-To kiosks add convenient access to engineering tools in major Stanton cities.

newContent.title: VR improvements
newContent.detail: Experimental VR gains eye-tracked cursor support, dominant-eye aiming and additional display controls.

fixes.title: Cargo and persistence
fixes.detail: Fixes address freight-platform item loss, missing persistent items and duplication exploits.

fixes.title: Ships and missions
fixes.detail: Fixes address engineering-related mission failures, repair fires and unresponsive controls after failed quantum jumps.

knownIssues.title: Event cargo and rewards
knownIssues.detail: Alliance Aid deliveries may lack cargo or award incorrect event points.

knownIssues.title: Ship persistence
knownIssues.detail: Ships bought with aUEC may fail to persist between patches.

watchouts: LAMP is available only on supported ships.
Some kiosks incorrectly display UEC; the affected transactions actually use aUEC.

brief.headline: Alpha 4.5 introduces ship engineering, component repair and fire management, alongside experimental VR support.
takeaways: Monitor power, atmosphere, component health and fires through the engineering terminal.
Damaged components degrade performance; crews can replace fuses and repair equipment in flight.
Ship armor, weapon balance, refining economics and dungeon rewards change substantially.

newContent.title: Engineering systems
newContent.detail: Manage power budgets, relays, cooling and life support; damaged power plants can trigger self-destruct.

newContent.title: Repair and firefighting
newContent.detail: Use repair tools with RMC, swap supported components, extinguish fires or vent sealed rooms.

newContent.title: Experimental VR
newContent.detail: Full VR and Theater Mode are available with dedicated controls and graphics settings.

fixes.title: Cargo and missions
fixes.detail: Fixes address Hull C automated loading and delivery, escort and salvage objectives.

fixes.title: Travel and locations
fixes.detail: Fixes address interrupted quantum travel, Levski elevators and docking issues.

knownIssues.title: World and mission blockers
knownIssues.detail: Some Distribution Centers lack collision; the Storm Breaker Apex Valakkar may not spawn.

knownIssues.title: Technical issues
knownIssues.detail: Vulkan initialization can fail, and freight-platform items may disappear after server errors.

watchouts: Size 3 and larger component replacements require docking.
VR remains experimental and can introduce additional performance issues.
